body.purpose: Row names, dialog titles, button labels, endpoint values.

small.purpose: Row metadata, serving badges, hints, status bar, filters.

dos: Do build new rows, bars, and panes from theme tokens (border, group_box, list_active, muted_foreground, danger, success) so light-theme changes propagate.
Do keep shortcut hints visible on buttons and full `Name (Key)` strings on accessible names and tooltips.
Do name affected rows in confirms, failures, and toasts — honesty is the brand voice.
Do keep the serving badge, dot, and detail Badge in agreement: green serving, red dead/failed, gray stopped.
Do preserve all control states when restyling: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, empty.
donts: Don't introduce display type, gradient text, glass, emoji icons, or shadows — the world is plain, flat, and unadorned by decision.
Don't spend color on decoration; blue is selection-only, green/red are state-only, black is primary-action-only.
Don't add a third text size or a second corner radius without replacing the system, not extending it.
Don't turn confirm dialogs into silent actions or collapse per-item import failures into a single toast.
Don't surface secrets: copy, logs, URLs, and search matching stay clear of credential fields.
keyCharacteristics: Ink on paper: near-black on white, quiet gray surfaces, hairline separators.
Signal-only color: blue marks selection, green/red mark serving state, black marks primary action.
Two-size type: names at base, metadata and status at small.
Flat hairline surfaces with a single 6px radius; pills only for dots and key chips.
narrative.overview: ManyProxy looks like the instrument it is: a plain, dense ledger of proxy endpoints where every row, badge, and toast reads as a labeled entry and nothing is unaccounted for. Surfaces stay paper-white and quiet gray; near-black ink carries names and actions; color appears only where it carries meaning. There is one typeface, two text sizes, one corner radius, and zero shadows. Every control names its action in a tooltip, every shortcut rides visibly on its button, and every consequential step confirms by naming the affected rows.

rules.body: Color marks primary actions, current selection, and serving state — never decoration.
rules.name: The Signal-Only Rule

rules.body: Names at base, metadata and status at small. No third size and no display faces in UI.
rules.name: The Two-Size Rule

rules.body: Crowded action sets wrap to a second row; panes scroll vertically only.
rules.name: The No-Sideways-Scroll Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Separation comes from hairlines and tonal bands.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule

rules.body: 6px on cards, fields, and buttons; pills only for dots, key chips, and small controls.
rules.name: The One-Radius Rule
